theme_strategy.mood: Trustworthy, calm, clean medical tech, highly user-friendly
theme_strategy.reasoning: A clinical reminder app needs to feel reliable but not sterile. Using an Organic & Earthy archetype with sage greens and bone whites creates a calming environment that reduces cognitive load for clinic staff while maintaining a highly professional appearance.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Do not cram data. The UI must feel breathable.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use 'The Control Room Grid' for dashboard stats. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Every pixel utilized intentionally.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI must be heavily customized. Strip out the 'Vercel-look'. Use flat surfaces, 1px subtle borders (#E5E9E6), and no heavy shadows. Flat solid backgrounds are mandatory for clinical apps to avoid visual refraction of data (no glassmorphism).
components.navigation: Sidebar with Manrope font, clear active states (using #4A5D4E), and a prominent Language Switcher (EN/HI) at the top right.
components.forms: Patient Add/Edit Form using Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Left-aligned labels, clear error states in #C86A58.
components.tables: Patient List with ample row height. Clear typographic hierarchy for medicine names and reminder times. Ensure left alignment for data.
components.cards: Stats cards using flat design with 1px border (#E5E9E6), no shadow by default, and a slight hover lift (-translate-y-1) with subtle shadow-sm.

accessibility_and_interactions.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA standards. Primary text on surface meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly set text color on hover.
accessibility_and_interactions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='add-patient-button').
accessibility_and_interactions.language: UI text must support toggling between English and Hindi seamlessly.

images.description: Login landing page hero background (warm medical clinic environment)
Abstract medical pills (can be used for empty states or generic backgrounds)
Friendly doctor portrait for dashboard user avatar
Modern waiting room interior for secondary layout graphics

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette in tailwind.config.js. Do NOT use default Tailwind blues, teals, or purples.
Implement language switching (EN/HI) natively or via i18n library. Ensure fonts support Devanagari script gracefully (Work Sans supports it via fallback, but ensure proper rendering).
Dashboard stats and Patient Lists must be responsive, defaulting to grid-cols-1 on mobile.
When integrating Shadcn, customize border-radius to match the rounded-2xl theme and use flat borders (#E5E9E6).
Avoid glassmorphism. Use flat solid backgrounds to ensure clinical data remains perfectly legible.
You MUST add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language toggles, table rows, etc.)
Apply Manrope for all Headings (H1-H4) and Work Sans for body text.
Use the provided image URLs exclusively for media assets.
